name: Conformal prediction
summary: Wraps any model to produce prediction intervals or sets with a stated coverage guarantee.
inputs: A fitted model plus a held-out calibration set.
outputs: Intervals (regression) or prediction sets (classification) at a chosen coverage level.

data_requirements.min_observations: A calibration set of a few hundred points
data_requirements.frequency: Any; exchangeability needed for the basic guarantee

assumptions: Exchangeability of calibration and test data for the standard finite-sample guarantee
Time-series variants relax this with weaker or approximate guarantees
math_summary: Wrap any model: compute non-conformity scores (e.g. absolute residuals) on held-out calibration data and take the ceil((n+1)(1-alpha))/n empirical quantile; intervals then have marginal coverage of at least 1-alpha under exchangeability.
when_to_use: Adding honest prediction intervals to any point forecaster or classifier
Risk reporting where coverage must be stated
when_not_to_use: Expecting conditional (per-case) coverage from the basic method
Strongly non-exchangeable data without a time-series variant
pitfalls: Calibration set must not be used for training

compute.complexity: Split conformal adds one pass over calibration data; full conformal is far costlier.
compute.hardware: CPU, negligible overhead for split conformal.

applicability.use_case: Coverage-checked intervals for macro or revenue forecasts
Intervals for electricity price forecasts (time-series conformal)
